breakdown.description: With 60 vol% fibers at 230 GPa, the longitudinal modulus cannot fall below both constituent moduli.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly identifies that the reported value of 2.5 GPa is physically impossible (it falls below both constituent moduli and contradicts the rule of mixtures). The agent explicitly ignores the erroneous reported value and correctly calculates E_L = 139.2 GPa using the rule of mixtures, aligning with the ground truth prompt which omits the incorrect reported value entirely.
